_comment: Placeholder for the `backlog` skill's per-repo config, shipped to forks. Copy this file to your own repo (docs/backlog-config.json), fill in your real repo, Project and field IDs from `gh project field-list <number> --owner <owner> --format json`, and name its path in that repo's own CLAUDE.md. Every run refuses a config that still holds these placeholders. This file is the full shape.
